answer: The forge creates a unique provenance token for each agent by hashing its signed seed together with a delta‑time stamp and storing the hash in a public orchard ledger. When an agent submits a request, validators retrieve the token, verify the seed matches the stored hash, and reject any submission whose token does not correspond to the original identity. To spawn a fake identity an attacker must lock up a fresh stake of 10 ETH per token and wait a 24‑hour delta before the ledger accepts the new token, making each Sybil cost 10 ETH and a day of delay.
